nibodhati.cp: ni + budh + a; attends, looks out for.
nibodhati.p: [Ni+budha+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) He knows; make it know (2) He knows completely; He made it known to all.

H: nibodhati：[ni-bodhati＜budh] 服侍，照顧，（拿）取（take）．caus．nibodheti 睡醒覺醒（to waken）．
S: nibodhati：[ni-bodhati＜budh] 仕える，世話する，取る．caus．nibodheti 目覚めさす．

nibodhati： nibodhati（kri）

P: Nibodhati，[ni+bodhati] to attend to，to look out for，to take J．III，151 （=gaṇhati）．-- Caus．nibodheti to waken，at Th．1，22 is probably to be read as vibodheti．（Page 361）

DOP: nibodhati pr. 3 sg. [ S. nibodhati], learns; attends to; listens to ; Ja III 134, 1* (yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ khippam eva ~ati) = Ap 563, 5 ; Ja III 151, 12* (yo vācaṃ sandhibhedassa pisunassa ~ati; 151, 27´ : ~ati gaṇhati); Bv-a 63, 6 (suṇāthā ti nisāmetha ~atha, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee suṇothā ti suṇātha ~atha); — caus. pr. 3 sg. nibodheti , teaches, instructs; rouses ; Th 22 (te … suttaṃ jhāyaṃ ~enti; Th-a I 82, 15 : ~entī ti pabodhenti, ime pi nāma niddaṃ anupagantvā jāgarantā attanā kattabbaṃ karonti, kimaṅgaṃ panāhan ti evaṃ sampajaññuppādanena sayanato vuṭṭhāpentī ti adhippāyo).
